notes: Size, white background, no glasses and ICAO compliance come from the official VFS checklist (May 2026).
Head height is disputed: ICAO Doc 9303 gives 32-36 mm (70-80%); several photo-tool sites say 80-85% or 36-38 mm. 36.0 mm is the only value inside every range.
The 630x810 px / 10-250 KB digital upload spec comes from third-party guides, not an official page we could reach.
Unofficial sources claim the Passport Seva portal rejects AI-edited backgrounds. Unverified.

headHeight.note: Target sits on the boundary of the ICAO and India-strict readings; see status.notes.

background.editingRisk: We replaced the background. Upload to the Passport Seva portal first; it checks the photo instantly.
